text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Taking that piece changes nothing. 
Struggle all you like, but my next move 
will claim your head.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: In other words— with this, it's checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? You're curious? Very well, I shall 
show you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The enemy couldn't even form a 
single line. And so, the only destination 
left for them was a dead end.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In other words, declaring riichi in front 
of me is nothing more than a risk—every 
bud of victory exists solely so that I may 
pluck it.
